summary: US CENTCOM concluded its 13th consecutive night of strikes on Iranian military targets, while Iran launched a new wave of ballistic missile attacks on Kuwaiti military facilities and US naval assets in Bahrain. In the West Bank, a deadly attack at Khvat Gilaad killed an Israeli settler and a soldier, prompting a large-scale IDF operation in the Jenin and Tulkarm areas. Iran also struck a US logistics warehouse in Saudi Arabia.
key_points: US CENTCOM completed the 13th consecutive night of strikes on Iranian military facilities, targeting command centers, drone bases, and naval capabilities in the Strait of Hormuz (Source: @VahidOnline/77459).
Iran's IRGC announced a new wave of ballistic missile attacks on the Al-Addiri base in Kuwait and the US Fifth Fleet observation tower in Bahrain (Source: @yediotnews25/133155).

An Israeli settler and an IDF soldier were killed in a shooting attack at Khvat Gilaad near the village of Tell in the West Bank; three attackers were later eliminated by IDF forces (Source: @idf_telegram/24700).
IDF launched a large-scale operational deployment in the Jenin and Tulkarm areas of the northern West Bank, including raids on homes and the seizure of weapons (Source: @idf_telegram/24700).
Reports indicate US logistics warehouses in the Saudi Arabian desert were struck by two drones, causing explosions (Source: @SharghDaily/174130).

Iranian state media reported explosions and loud booms in multiple cities including Khondab, Taft, Borujerd, and Naein, with US strikes confirmed northwest of Ahvaz in Khuzestan Province (Source: @shin_persian/8481).

Israeli PM Netanyahu and Defense Minister Katz ordered the demolition of the attacker's home, reinforcement of forces across the West Bank, and the establishment of new outposts (Source: @amitsegal/63343).

sections.executive_summary: US CENTCOM concluded its 13th consecutive night of strikes on Iranian military targets, while Iran launched a new wave of ballistic missile attacks on Kuwaiti military facilities and US naval assets in Bahrain. In the West Bank, a deadly attack at Khvat Gilaad killed an Israeli settler and a soldier, prompting a large-scale IDF operation in the Jenin and Tulkarm areas. Iran also struck a US logistics warehouse in Saudi Arabia.
iran: Iran's IRGC announced a new wave of ballistic missile attacks targeting the Al-Addiri base in Kuwait and the US Fifth Fleet observation tower in Bahrain (Source: @yediotnews25/133155).

Iranian state media reported explosions and loud booms in Khondab, Taft, Borujerd, Naein, and other cities in Isfahan and Yazd provinces, with reports of military aircraft and missile fire (Source: @VahidOnline/77460).
US strikes targeted a base northwest of Ahvaz in Khuzestan Province, Iran, creating two fire hotspots at a base and a weapons depot (Source: @shin_persian/8481).
Iranian Foreign Minister Abbas Araghchi met with Chinese Foreign Minister Wang Yi on the sidelines of the SCO Council of Foreign Ministers' Meeting in Kyrgyzstan (Source: @presstv/200185).
Iranian state media reported that Iraqi PM's office denied a New York Times report about Iraqi mediation between the US and Iran, calling it baseless (Source: @naya_foriraq/85351).
israel: IDF Chief of Staff Lt. Gen. Eyal Zamir held a situational assessment following the deadly attack in the village of Tell in the Samaria region, ordering broad reinforcement of forces and the capture of all involved militants (Source: @almogboker78/17804).

Israeli PM Netanyahu and Defense Minister Katz ordered the demolition of the attacker's home near the village of Tell, intensive operations in terror-affiliated villages, weapon confiscation, and the establishment of new outposts (Source: @amitsegal/63343).

IDF forces began extensive operational activity in the Jenin and Tulkarm areas, entering the home of a terrorist who attacked and lightly wounded an IDF fighter in the Ginnos area of Menashe (Source: @idf_telegram/24700).

Shin Bet chief David Zini held an assessment at the site of the deadly clash in the West Bank village of Tell, stating the attack was severe and that dozens of attacks had been foiled in recent months (Source: @manniefabian/58847).

A 54-year-old worker was moderately injured after falling from a ladder during work on Rothschild Boulevard in Netanya; Magen David Adom paramedics treated and evacuated him to Laniado Hospital (Source: @N12chat/218981).
gaza_west_bank: An Israeli civilian and an IDF soldier were killed and injured in a shooting attack at Khvat Gilaad near the village of Tell in the West Bank; three attackers were eliminated (Source: @idf_telegram/24700).
IDF forces conducted raids in the Jenin and Tulkarm areas, entering homes, searching buildings, and detaining suspects as part of counter-terror operations (Source: @idf_telegram/24700).
Palestinian militants stormed the Nablus Specialized Hospital, harassing medical crews, employees, and civilians and detaining them during the raid (Source: @rasedal3ado138e/380446).
Israeli security forces killed three militants and continued operations in the village of Tell and surrounding areas in the northern West Bank (Source: @idf_telegram/24700).

Iraqi security sources reported that explosions in Saudi Arabia targeted US military logistics warehouses in the desert, with two drones striking the sites (Source: @SharghDaily/174130).

sections.threat_assessment: The operational tempo has escalated significantly, with the US conducting its 13th consecutive night of strikes on Iranian military infrastructure while Iran retaliates with ballistic missile salvos targeting US allies in the Gulf. The IDF's large-scale deployment in the northern West Bank following the Khvat Gilaad attack raises the risk of further friction and escalation. The targeting of US logistics in Saudi Arabia and the IRGC's strikes on Kuwait and Bahrain indicate a widening theater of operations that threatens regional stability and US force posture.
sections.regional_response: Regional actors are responding with heightened alertness: Gulf states have issued urgent warnings for citizens to stay 500 meters from military and US facilities, while Iraq has publicly denied any mediation role between the US and Iran. Iran is leveraging its ballistic missile capability to strike US allies, and the IDF is conducting extensive counter-terror operations in the West Bank to prevent further attacks.
sections.intelligence_notes: The convergence of US strikes on Iran, Iranian missile attacks on Gulf states, and IDF operations in the West Bank suggests a multi-front escalation. The targeting of US logistics in Saudi Arabia and the IRGC's focus on naval assets in Bahrain and Kuwait indicate a deliberate effort to challenge US force projection. The Shin Bet's admission that the West Bank attack was not prevented in advance highlights intelligence gaps that may require operational adjustments.
